name: KINERGY
recent: Kinergy近期获得Gamuda子公司价值RM47.5百万的数据中心电气工程合约，并推进最多10%新股配售计划，已获Bursa Securities批准。同时，公司执行董事Dato' Seri Nazir Hussin辞职，大股东兼执行副主席Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn在闭市期外增持股份。
notable: 获得Gamuda子公司价值RM47.5百万的数据中心电气工程合约。
497,717股新股（占已发行股份10%），已获Bursa Securities批准。
执行董事Dato' Seri Nazir Hussin辞职。
risks: 可能摊薄现有股东持股。
执行副主席兼集团董事经理Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn在闭市期外增持8,100,000股。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM109.382百万，环比增长7.2%，同比增长11.9%；净利为RM9.055百万，环比增长22.8%，同比增长39.5%；净利率为8.3%，高于上一季度的7.2%。

recent_en: Kinergy recently secured a RM47.5 million electrical works contract for a hyperscale data centre from a Gamuda unit, and is proceeding with a proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares, which has received Bursa Securities approval. Meanwhile, Executive Director Dato' Seri Nazir Hussin resigned, and Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn acquired shares outside the closed period.
notable_en: Secured a RM47.5 million electrical works contract for a data centre from a Gamuda unit.
Proposed private placement of up to 218,497,717 new shares (10% of issued shares), approved by Bursa Securities.
Executive Director Dato' Seri Nazir Hussin resigned.
risks_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Executive Deputy Chairman cum Group Managing Director Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn acquired 8,100,000 shares outside the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM109.382 million, up 7.2% QoQ and 11.9% YoY; net income was RM9.055 million, up 22.8% QoQ and 39.5% YoY; net margin was 8.3%, higher than 7.2% in the previous quarter.
